newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cluff finds more diamonds in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Cluff finds more diamonds in Australia.

text.p: Cluff Resources Pacific NL said on Monday it had found a further 83 diamonds in the Copeton Dam region in the north of New South Wales.

Cluff said it recovered 56 gem quality diamonds and one industrial boart (finely crystalline industrial stone) from tailings and mullock (mine refuse) surrounding shafts at the Doctors Workings prospect.
The stones averaged four stones to the carat, including 16 stones averaging half a carat.

Another 16 gem quality diamonds weighing a total of three carats were recovered from tailings and mullock from the Streak of Luck tunnel and 10 diamonds were recovered from the upper part of the Doctors Workings.
Cluff said it expected the lower parts of the Doctors Workings to have higher grades.
Diamonds have been recovered from the Copeton area since the late nineteenth century.
